facts.text: EthernetOscilloscope is a stub: its constructor logs that Ethernet is not implemented and every method delegates to a SimulatedOscilloscope
The simulated oscilloscope initializes four channels with a default timebase and trigger
configure_channels raises ValueError for a channel outside range(4)
set_timebase clamps the sample rate to max_sample_rate and the record length to max_memory_depth
The capability record states max_sample_rate 1e9, max_bandwidth 500e6, max_channels 4 and max_memory_depth 1e9
The capability record states a voltage range of 0.001 to 100.0 and lists DC, AC and GND coupling and 50 and 1M impedance
The supported trigger types are edge, pulse, pattern and protocol
get_status reports initialized, acquisition_active, channels, timebase and trigger_config
setup_trigger stores the source, type, level, edge and holdoff in trigger_config
acquire_waveform builds waveform_data with a shared time axis and per-channel voltage arrays
cleanup stops the acquisition before marking the oscilloscope uninitialized
The README describes multi-channel acquisition with 4 channels and configurable sample rates
